newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse extends losses in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse extends losses in volatile trade.

text.p: The Madrid bourse extended early losses by midday on Thursday in thin, volatile trade ahead of a three-day holiday weekend, dealers said.
Dealers said it was difficult to predict the short term outlook in the current climate and they would look to Wall Street for inspiration.

The general index slipped 5.65 points, 0.92 percent, to 607.11. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares fell 68.90 points, 0.99 percent, to 6,890.02. Turnover was lower than in previous sessions with 24 billion pesetas changing hands. "The market is very volatile and it is impossible to make forecasts for the short term," one dealer said.
